# Month Range Picker

Choose an inclusive span of calendar months from one year grid.

## Usage

### Reporting period

Choose the first and last month included in a report.

<ComponentExample component="month-range-picker" scenario="reporting-period" title="Reporting period" description="Choose the first and last month included in a report." :index="0" />

### Bounded

Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum.

<ComponentExample component="month-range-picker" scenario="bounded" title="Bounded" description="Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="month-range-picker" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Floating positioning

This component uses the shared positioning engine. Use the [live positioning example](/guides/positioning) to change `side`, `align`, offsets, collision boundaries, strategy, and tracking while inspecting the resolved placement.

## Style available and selected dates

Style availability and selection from the public ARIA state on calendar cells. You do not need a second visual-only list that can drift from the component policies.

```css
[data-scope='month-range-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-selected='true'] {
  background: CanvasText;
  color: Canvas;
}

[data-scope='month-range-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-disabled='true'] {
  opacity: .45;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
```

For SSR or tests that need a stable initial month, set the API `referenceDate` so the first rendered view does not depend on the current clock.

## Accessibility

Start and end month inputs share one year grid while retaining independently named endpoints.
